about: Report Missing or inaccurate content in the documentation to improve clarity
  and accuracy
title: "[BUG]"
labels: bug, invalid
assignees: ''

---

### Description of Issue
Does a section have missing information/ inaccurate information/ spelling mistakes/ broken links/ any other cosmetic issue?

### Location of the Issue
Provide the exact location of the issue. Include links to specific pages, sections, or lines within the documentation if possible.

### Suggested Fix
If you have suggestions for addressing this issue, provide them here. This could include:
- The correct information or updated details.
- Suggestions for additional information or clarification.
- Links to external resources or sources that support the correct information.
